propositions: Two backend-neutral core modules (outbound_comments.py and inbound_translate.py) load Jira-specific rich-text and comment-limit modules by hard-coded lazy-load keys, causing vendor code to execute unconditionally for any configured backend.

The literal lazy-key strings 'rebar_reconciler.adapters.jira.adf' and 'rebar_reconciler.adapters.jira.comment_limits' must be eliminated from backend-neutral core paths to achieve the port's separation goal that a second backend can drop in without Jira-specific code paths.

Comment formatting and truncation on the outbound diff path must route through FieldSanitizer.fit_comment() instead of direct lazy-loading, while inbound rich-text normalization must route through InboundMapper.normalize_rich_text() instead of direct lazy-loading.

Outbound-comment ADF decoding (for comment-diff dedup) and inbound ADF normalization (defense-in-depth for bug 1bb2-5da5) must both use the same backend-neutral normalize_rich_text surface to preserve behavior while eliminating vendor literals.
